|errata_history=This is the original (version 1 of 3, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[The Dead Speak! (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
* '''Original''' (this page, 18 March 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (18 March 2021). Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-thedeadspeak-20210318.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/thedeadspeak.png Holotable commit c241f88 “vset14”], no mark). Text: “If I Will Finish What You Started on table, deploy on table. May ▼ Sith Throne. While [Episode VII] Emperor on Exegol, attrition against opponent is +2 at same location as Kylo, Pryde, or Rey. Your [Episode I] characters are lost. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Dead Speak! (Errata)]], 22 June 2021): Players Committee card image, 22 June 2021: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-thedeadspeak-20210622.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/the_dead_speak.png Holotable commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images”], mark “E1”). Text: “If I Will Finish What You Started on table, deploy on table. While [Episode VII] Emperor on Exegol, attrition against opponent is +2 at same location as Kylo, Rey, or Snoke and, once per game, may ▼ an [Episode VII] battleground system. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' “May ▼ Sith Throne.” and “Your [Episode I] characters are lost.” are gone; “Kylo, Pryde, or Rey” became “Kylo, Rey, or Snoke”; new: “and, once per game, may ▼ an [Episode VII] battleground system”. The card prints the errata mark “E1”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[The Dead Speak! (Errata 2)]], 31 May 2022): Players Committee card image, 31 May 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-thedeadspeak.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/13a5f3a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/thedeadspeak.png Holotable commit 13a5f3a “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”], mark “E1”). Text: “If I Will Finish What You Started on table, deploy on table. While [Episode VII] Emperor on Exegol, attrition against opponent is +2 at same location as Kylo, Rey, or Snoke and, once per game, may ▼ an [Episode VII] battleground system. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details: art credit “Tanis Teau @ ArtStation” (was “@ ArtStation.com”) and copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”; the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
|hatnote=Other versions of this card: [[The Dead Speak! (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[The Dead Speak! (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
